ns2:course.label: LLM Legal Writing and Research
ns2:course.description: Designed and developed to equip incoming LL.M students with the necessary background in U.S. constitutional law, legal research, analysis, and writing for effective classroom performance. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Admission to the U.S. LLM program.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Admission to the U.S. LLM program.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Law department.
